name: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
summary: Narain cannot translate anything without the scrying goggles. Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F., has them, and you need to bring them back.

sections.title: The Stolen Goggles
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy cannot translate anything without the scrying goggles. Stewvul was once Narain's best friend forever, but stole them a while ago. Then Stewvul broke Narain's heart in five places and abandoned Narain here.

sections.title: Where to Look
sections.body: Narain's crystal ball points to two places where Stewvul might be. One is the Greymane Wall in Silverpine. The other lies beyond a portal. You need to find Stewvul and bring back the goggles.

sections.title: What Stewvul Says
sections.body: Stewvul cannot believe Narain has found them. Stewvul refuses to return, weary of being a friend only part of the time and a slave the rest.

faq.q: Why does Narain need the scrying goggles?
faq.answer: Narain says nothing can be translated without the scrying goggles.
Stewvul is Narain Soothfancy's ex-best friend forever. Stewvul stole the scrying goggles, broke Narain's heart in five places, then abandoned Narain here.

faq.q: Where does Narain think Stewvul is?
faq.answer: Narain's crystal ball points to two possible places: the Greymane Wall in Silverpine or a world beyond a portal.
Before this, you brought Azuregos's ledger to Narain in Translating the Ledger.
